project.name: Sifra
project.descriptor: A secure, user-owned password vault evolving into a cross-platform, zero-knowledge digital vault and personal security platform.

guardrails.statement: The system must separate cloud-storage authentication from vault authentication.

requirements.statement: The system must allow a user to create a vault with a master password.
The system must generate a one-time recovery key during vault creation.
The system must support adding, viewing, editing, deleting, and searching login credentials.
The system must generate strong passwords for user credentials.
The system must allow manual copying of usernames and passwords.
The system must lock and unlock the vault, rejecting incorrect passwords.
The system must persist encrypted vault data locally without data loss on close/reopen.
The system must allow changing the master password without re-encrypting all secrets.
The system must support vault recovery using the recovery key to establish a new master password.
The system must use Google Drive for encrypted cross-device synchronization.
The system must use Microsoft OneDrive and Dropbox for encrypted cross-device synchronization after Google Drive.
The system must separate cloud-storage authentication from vault authentication.
The system must use established cryptographic libraries and primitives for encryption.
The system must support local-first operation with offline usability.
The system must support device identity and revocation.
The system must support browser integration for credential discovery and autofill.
The system must provide secure sharing of credentials and vaults.
The system must support password health analysis and breach awareness.

stories.title: Create Vault and Generate Recovery Key
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to create a vault with a master password and receive a one-time recovery key.

stories.title: Separate Cloud-Storage Authentication from Vault Authentication
stories.narrative: As a user, I want cloud-storage sign-in kept separate from my vault authentication.

stories.title: Support Local-First Operation with Offline Usability
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to use my vault fully offline with data persisted locally.

stories.title: Establish Trust Spine for Vault Operations
stories.narrative: As the system, I want a trust spine built on established cryptographic primitives underlying all vault operations.

stories.title: Add, View, Edit, Delete, and Search Credentials
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to add, view, edit, delete, and search my login credentials.

stories.title: Generate Strong Passwords
stories.narrative: As a user, I want the system to generate strong passwords for my credentials.

stories.title: Lock and Unlock Vault
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to lock and unlock my vault, with incorrect passwords rejected.

stories.title: Change Master Password
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to change my master password without re-encrypting all my secrets.

stories.title: Recover Vault with Recovery Key
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to recover my vault using my recovery key if I forget my master password.

stories.title: Synchronize Vault with Google Drive
stories.narrative: As a user, I want my vault synchronized across devices using Google Drive.

stories.title: Synchronize Vault with OneDrive and Dropbox
stories.narrative: As a user, I want my vault synchronized using OneDrive and Dropbox as well.

stories.title: Manage Device Identity and Revocation
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to identify and revoke devices linked to my vault.

stories.title: Browser Integration for Credential Autofill
stories.narrative: As a user, I want browser integration to discover and autofill my credentials.

stories.title: Analyze Password Health and Breach Awareness
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to see password health analysis and breach awareness for my credentials.

stories.title: Secure Sharing of Credentials
stories.narrative: As a user, I want to securely share credentials and vaults with others.
